notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate an Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2.
